name: Techendo

sources.title: Startups section — 'a place to share either your betas or betas of services you find interesting'; active listing pages with 'Add beta' button
Registration — username, group (Company/Person), email, password, about, city selector

conditions: Free, but requires a registered account (Sign Up at /auth/register); the 'Add beta' flow sits behind login
requirements: Pitch is to the 'Startups' section: 'share either your betas or betas of services you find interesting. Any new site is welcome'
Registration requires username, group (Company or Person), email, password, About, and city
Community norms stated: 'You can get feedback, hold conversations... Be awesome to one another'
Listing fields visible on cards: product name, country, status ('Recently Launched'), categories (Mobile, SaaS, Cloud, Blockchain, Web Development, etc.), review count
preparation: Product name, country, categories, a logo/screenshot and description for the profile page
A live product URL — entries get 'View profile' pages at /beta/<slug>.html
workflow: Register at https://techendo.com/auth/register (choose Company for a product entity)
Log in, open https://techendo.com/beta and use 'Add beta'
Fill the product profile (name, categories, country, description, link)
Published entries appear on /beta with 'Recently launched' status and a profile page
watchFor: The 'Add beta' button renders with a PHP template notice ('Undefined variable: href') — the link may be broken or login-gated; if it fails, use /auth/register then retry or use /pages/contact.html
Site shows unpatched PHP notices — an aging custom codebase
Section also accepts sharing 'betas of services you find interesting', so not every lister is the founder
Techendo is a broad IT content site; the beta board is a small community feature, not a high-traffic launchpad
countsAsLive: The product appears on https://techendo.com/beta with its own /beta/<slug>.html profile page showing status and categories
unknowns: Whether 'Add beta' is currently functional given the template bug
Whether profile pages link out with a followed URL
